purpose: Keep Jarvis memory entries as safe summaries before storage.

redaction_rules.description: Store summary, status, source reference, and decision only. Do not store full bodies.
Mask direct identifiers unless a Commander-approved summary requires a non-sensitive label.
Never store access strings, session strings, or credential-like content in memory.
Keep enough source reference to retrieve the original approved evidence trail.
Keep locked, validated, planned, stale, conflicting, blocked, or needs-review status.
